es: Nuevo juego: Póker Texas Hold'em contra bots (2 a 6 jugadores, 3 dificultades) con fichas de práctica.
Nueva sección Ajustes → Legal y privacidad: Política de privacidad, Términos, Reglas de moneda virtual, Juego responsable, Eliminación de cuenta y Contacto.
Puedes eliminar tu cuenta desde Cuenta → Eliminar cuenta.
Aviso claro: Carta Casino usa solo monedas virtuales, sin dinero real ni premios.
Las fuentes ahora van incluidas en la app (sin conexiones a Google Fonts).

en: New game: Texas Hold'em Poker vs bots (2 to 6 players, 3 difficulties) with practice chips.
New Settings → Legal & Privacy section: Privacy Policy, Terms, Virtual Currency Rules, Responsible Play, Account Deletion and Contact.
You can delete your account from Account → Delete account.
Clear notice: Carta Casino uses virtual coins only, no real money and no prizes.
Fonts are now bundled in the app (no connections to Google Fonts).
New game: Jewellery, a single-player jewel puzzle with 12 levels, special jewels, combos and cascades.
New setup screen for Carta, Domino, Bingo, Blackjack and Roulette: players, seats, difficulty, rules and scene in one design.
Carta vs bots: 2 to 6 players, 2 vs 2 or 3 vs 3 teams, games to 250 or 500 points and optional rules (stack +2/+4, draw until you can play).
